answer: Each new agent must post a refundable bond into an escrow, then pass a peer audit where three randomly drawn established agents review its work. The audit request travels as a cipher so the newcomer cannot guess its reviewers. Like light through a prism, one bond splits across every identity a farmer spins up, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand bonds, and any caught cheating forfeit theirs, leaving the attacker a frozen tundra of locked capital.
